transcript: Speaker A: पांच बच्चों के साथ ट्रेन में अकेला छोड़ गया। नमस्ते, मेरा नाम सायरा है... [He left me alone on the train with five children. Namaste, my name is Saira...] (Saira narrates being abandoned by her husband, facing job rejections due to lack of English, and finding hope through the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial. She practiced with the AI coach, secured a call center job, and now earns 38,000 INR. She encourages other women to learn English to stand on their own feet). Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government or brand. Content is dramatized for representation. Results depend on individual effort.]
summary: A woman shares her story of being abandoned with five children and overcoming poverty by learning English on the English Seekho app. After securing a job and raising her income, she encourages other struggling women to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
